description: Tailscale for jailbroken PS5: reach the console over your tailnet and stream to it with Moonlight/Sunshine (unofficial)
Allows for PKG games on USB external devices to mount on jailbroken PS5s without installing on internal storage or PS5 formatted USB storage
Standalone PS5 payload for compressing, unpacking, validating, and repairing ShadowMountPlus-mounted games
Bluetooth A2DP audio bridge for PS5 homebrew
A Bluetooth controller bridge for jailbroken PS5 consoles. Un puente de mandos Bluetooth para PS5 con jailbreak.
Unlocks 60 FPS in Red Dead Redemption 2 (PS4, v1.32) on a jailbroken PS5, and on a 1080p TV renders the game's own PS4 Pro 4K checkerboard, shown at 1080p (supersampled).
Unlock 60 FPS in PS4 and PS5 games on a jailbroken PS5, with one switch per game.
Standalone PS5 on-console payload to move apps between Games/Media tabs and hide offline PSN bloatware (FW 13.60 supported).
A PS5 and PS4 payload that stops the console from going into rest mode while it runs.

OnionHEN is a homebrew enabler and Toolbox for jailbroken PS5 consoles, built on etaHEN. It prepares the system, injects a Toolbox into the home screen, and adds cheats, in-game overlays, payload management, and background services.

Kernel patcher for the full PS5 firmware range. Resolves kernel symbols at runtime via the SDK's NID table, so the same binary covers FW 1.00–12.x. Required by ShadowMountPlus and most other privileged payloads. Load this first.

Fully automated background 'Auto-Mounter' payload for jailbroken PS5. Watches scan folders for game folders and .ffpkg/.exfat/.ffpfs/.ffpfsc images, auto-mounts them, stages sce_sys + appmeta + trophy data, and registers them on the home screen.
Unofficial etaHEN 2.5B unified PS5 11.00-13.60 port: Toolbox, plugins and PS4/PS5 FPS. Original etaHEN by LightningMods and contributors.
A simple FTP server for jailbroken PS4s and PS5s
This is a simple FTP server that can be executed on a Playstation 4 or Playstation 5 that has been jailbroken and is running an ELF loader. The FTP server accepts connection on port 2121.
HTTP server on :8080 serving a homebrew launcher page. Pairs with the homebrew bundles distributed by ps5-payload-dev.
Telnet server on :2323 with 42 POSIX-ish commands plus hbldr (launch unsigned ELF with full A/V) and hbdbg (gdb-style debugger).
Streams /dev/klog over TCP :3232 and tees it to /data/klog/klog.log (10-backup rotation).
An ELF loader for jailbroken PS5s that accepts payloads on port 9021.
Minimal DNS server running on the PS5 (UDP :53). Blocks PlayStation Network + update domains by default and can redirect any domain to a LAN IP.
Loads and applies game cheats on the PS5. Send it like any other payload, then browse and toggle cheats for supported titles on the console.

Zero-copy FTP/HTTP server.
A modern, web-based dashboard to easily manage, import, and automatically load payloads on your PS5.

PS5 save decrypt/encrypt/browse with embedded web UI.
ELF payload for PS4/PS5 that fakes PSN sign-in for the foreground user by writing NP files and patching registry/ShellCore state.
Web-based file manager for jailbroken PS5. Serves a browser UI over HTTP so you can browse, transfer, and manage files on the console's internal storage from any device on the LAN.
A separate extraction helper for PS5 Web File Manager. It uses 7-Zip's native archive handlers and runs as an independent PS5 payload.

A standalone on-screen performance overlay for the PS5. It draws FPS, frametimes, 1% lows, CPU/SoC temperatures, and RAM/VRAM usage directly over your games.

A PS5 media and video player that also functions as a complete media library, with support for subtitles, multiple audio tracks, aspect-ratio adjustment, cropping, and many other playback settings.
Use a wireless DualShock 4 in native PS5 games on jailbroken consoles.

Shrink your PS5 games on the console itself. Pick a game, choose Compress with LZ4, and it packs the game data into LZ4 asset packs that APR-EMU reads while the game runs. Every file gets checked before anything's deleted, and if the game doesn't ship APR-EMU, the right runtime is added for you.
007 First Light (PPSA11386) online on a jailbroken PS5, with no IOI servers involved and no PC needed. One payload does everything on the console, so the online features and TacSim work.
Nuvio as a PS5 app, with a native 4K HDR player built for the console's own video hardware.

Update your installed PS5 games in a few taps, on the console. Finds the newest official update for each game and installs it, and applies a backport when an update needs a newer firmware than yours. No PC needed.
